proof_body:
by
  intro f L M hf h1 h2
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (h1.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds L (half_pos hε)))
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := Filter.eventually_atBot.1 (h2.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds M (half_pos hε)))
  have huc := (isCompact_Icc (a := A - 1) (b := B + 1)).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hf.continuousOn
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at huc
  obtain ⟨δ0, hδ0, h0⟩ := huc ε hε
  refine ⟨min δ0 1, lt_min hδ0 one_pos, fun x y hxy => ?_⟩
  have h3 : dist x y < δ0 := hxy.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have h4 : |x - y| < 1 := by
    have h := hxy.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at h
  obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := abs_lt.1 h4
  by_cases hbig : B ≤ x ∧ B ≤ y
  · have hx := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hB x hbig.1)
    have hy := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hB y hbig.2)
    exact (dist_triangle_right _ _ L).trans_lt (by linarith)
  · by_cases hsmall : x ≤ A ∧ y ≤ A
    · have hx := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hA x hsmall.1)
      have hy := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hA y hsmall.2)
      exact (dist_triangle_right _ _ M).trans_lt (by linarith)
    · have hx1 : A - 1 ≤ x := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        exact hsmall ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hx2 : x ≤ B + 1 := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        exact hbig ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hy1 : A - 1 ≤ y := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        exact hsmall ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hy2 : y ≤ B + 1 := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        exact hbig ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      exact h0 x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ y ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ h3
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L M : ℝ), Continuous f → Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds L) → Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atBot (nhds M) → UniformContinuous f
